about_the_game:
A star changed the laws of nature.

They changed the laws of humanity, and you can change everything.

Letum was once a paradise until the star Potens miraculously turned into a black hole and something ancient heard its call.

They came not to destroy, but to convert cities into towering monoliths, people into the aliens' own entertainment and the sky into a prison.

Now deep, buried within the aliens' monoliths, one survivor rose. Armed with scrap and objects carved from gravity itself. only you can undo the horrific changes they have made.

Fight like a machine with soul and purpose.

Tackle a wide range of brutal and dynamic combat encounters:

  • Start with a basic weapon and expand its power using scraps you find along your journey.

  • Upgrade yourself using powerful relics that can alter the very physics around you.

Survive the Monoliths shifting maze:

  • A procedural labyrinth reconfigures around you, lets just hope you can persuade its direction.

  • No two runs are ever the same.

  • Speedy and energetic enemies make for a challenging combat experience.

Delve deeper into Letum's broken mind.

  • Find clues along the way to help you puzzle together the horrifying truth that is Letum and its inhabitants.

  • Uncover a story where reality and imagination blur.

  • Unlock hidden secrets and fun game modes to really give you a challenge.

Each floor you climb could very well be your breaking point.

Explore the impossible.

Fight like a machine with soul and purpose.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains violence, gore and minor sexual language.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz or Higher
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz or Higher
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1660 Super
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: First Person Rogue-like with an incentive of choice. Set on a planet where a silent war between an alien race and a human soldier rage on. Craft your own build with self made weapons and personalized upgrades. Erratic enemies keep you on your toes so Fight like a machine with soul and purpose.
